description: The due-diligence report on one vault, cut to what an agent acts on (also simulationEvidence, liquidityLineage, notLentCoverage, unassessedCollateral, depositorsOverview, crossCheck): overallAssessment (published, conditional or withheld; publishedBand is null when withheld and partialBand is never the verdict), findings above the band, each risk dimension, capital (allocationState: an undated idle figure makes no deployed amount) and withdrawal bounds, crowding (a model score 0..1, never a share of capital, beside the observed allocation share), holderPipelines, metricStatus (each input current, indicative, stale, unavailable or not-read, with its times and expiry), completeness, warnings and agentRules. Follow agentRules when you answer: they say what must be quoted and what must not be said. `venueRelationship` (Hyperliquid only): vaultType protocol-child-strategy or protocol-parent, the parent, the parent’s direct share, underlyingHolderConcentration (unknown: a child’s direct concentration is not its depositors’), the route in and lock-up, and the commission the venue publishes. `returnMethod`: where the return comes from (share price, or the venue’s account value and profit), period, flow and fee treatment; status range or not_established is quoted as such, never as one figure. A metricStatus with valuePresent false is not read, whatever its times. PAID ($5 over x402, or inside a plan with due diligence). The digest names the whole issued document; verify it at /v1/reports/{digest}. materialLimits.simulationRecord carries each simulated try as raw assets, token decimals, price source, block hash and exact calldata, so it can be replayed; a highest passing size is never the exact maximum. A zero-amount call is never a limit (withdrawalBounds). On Morpho V2, forceDeallocate returns penalty SHARES burned and pays nobody: only the withdraw after it pays (exitSimulation.forceDeallocate). control.ownerControl says when owner control is not established; a curator’s Safe is never the owner’s.
name: vault_due_diligence

agentRules.description: What your answer must and must not say. Follow them.

changesSincePrevious.description: Standard figures before and after against the previous report, each changed, below_threshold (moved, under the 1% materiality threshold), unchanged (within a dollar) or not_comparable, with a note that says the move, with both times and models.

collateralLookThrough.description: Borrowers’ collateral followed past the token: each path with relation (borrower collateral), chain, beyond (documented hops), end (native, staking, custodial, issuer-backed, private credit, not established) and population (shares are of the markets read; 100% is of the known population unless the whole vault was read).

completeness.description: Coverage by area, missing fields, currentDecisionStatus, nextCurrentInputExpiryAt, snapshot.

control.description: says, ownerControl, powers (each typed: name, selector, contract, chain, block, delaySeconds, abdicated, status disabled | not-established | immediate | delayed, state, pending, evidence, says; an abdicated power is disabled whatever its stored delay), powerGroups (new destinations, moving among adapters already added, caps, gates, fees, the vault behind each adapter) and controllerReadings (onchainRolesObserved, curatorPowersRead, ownerSigningScheme, beneficialControllerIdentified, controllerRiskAssessed, each with state, source and block). Roles read are described; a controller risk not assessed is said as that.

decisionSummary.description: The one decision view model: modelScore, modelBand, highestModelDimension, highestFindingAcrossAllLayers (the lending-book overlay and the controller included), publishedBand, overrideReasons (rule, evidence, readAt), materialFindings, and lines to quote; weightedModel (band, score), highestFinding, overrides, decisionUsability and bandSays, the one sentence naming the published band and why apart from the weighted model. Lead with highestFindingAcrossAllLayers; never say nothing material was read while materialFindings is not empty; never call a band an overlay set the model band; a withheld assessment has no band. SINCE 2026-11-25 (R-03) also `assessmentHierarchy`: weightedModelBand, weightedModelScore, highestBaseModelDimension (a dimension, never “the base model”), highestKnownFinding, publishedBand, overrideReasons, decisionUsability, hierarchySays (“Highest base-model dimension: liquidity / high; weighted model: low, 19/100; published band: severe because of the lending-book overlay.”), the risk chart’s lines and legend and the methodology heading; every title, chart, legend and sentence about the result reads these fields.

decisionUsability.description: The one answer to whether the result may be acted on now: state current, indicative, conditional, limited, withheld or unavailable, with usable, label, reason, reasonCode, policy (the precedence) and inputs, each with present, withinRefreshTarget (the 26-hour age rule), aligned (the 30-minute rule for two readings), usableForCurrentDecision and observedAt. present counts inputs read, never inputs usable now. Quote the label and reason with the band.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the whole issued document: the authoritative report id, all 64 characters. The 12-character id printed on the PDF is for display only.

dimensions.description: Each risk dimension with its level and what set it.

evidenceTimes.description: baseModelInputTimeRange and allDecisionEvidenceTimeRange (overlay, oracle, credit, simulation included), each with oldest, newest and unknown. Quote "oldest known" whenever unknown is not empty.

gradeTraces.description: What set each grade that moves the band: ruleVersion, setBy, inputs with times, newerObservation; reassessed false means grade based on older reading, impact of newer feed not reassessed.

highestFinding.description: The worst single risk read, level and label. The weighted result never cancels it.

issueData.description: What ASPERN already held at issue, frozen with each input’s time (2026-11-25): collateralShock, gradeTrace, priceEvidence, yieldSamePeriod, exitMetadata, venueWarnings, protocolAudits, maturityLadder, migrationTiers, holderBehaviour, agentFlows, and summaryLine. Each block has state available, partial, not available at issue (with liveUrl) or not applicable. Absent on documents issued before.

liquidityLineage.description: Every liquidity ratio the model chose between, with the one it took. Null on a document written before 2026-11-24. Each side has sourceReadingId, rawValue, unit, observedAt, snapshotDate, precision and usdConversion; selectedRatio.matchedBy not-recorded means the scorer kept no times: say its alignment and freshness are unknown, never borrow another candidate’s time.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

metricStatus.description: Per input: status, times, expiry, whether the result used it.

notAssessed.description: Risk areas this report did not assess, each with status not assessed, not tested or not established. Say them; the score’s input share does not cover them.

notLentCoverage.description: Whether the daily not-lent book covers the vault; a share without coverage is null, never 0.

overallAssessment.description: status, publishedBand, publishedScore, partialBand, partialScore, reasonCode, reason, findingsAboveBand, inputsNotCurrent, judgedAt. usableForCurrentDecision false: the score is a historical computation, not a clearance; sensitivity gives each not-current input’s score without it and at its worst. inputsStatus gives present, fresh, aligned, usable and covered per input, five separate answers.

reportCoverage.description: The report coverage manifest: one row per section with available, inPdf, inJson, paidWithheld, unread and freshness (oldest and newest source time against the issue). Absent on documents issued before.

reportIssue.description: The issue around the document, outside its digest (2026-11-24): reportId (the full digest, authoritative) and displayId; times kept apart: reportIssuedAt (the issue record), readingsAt, pdfRenderedAt (null here, no PDF), sourceObservedAt (oldest and newest critical input, with the figure each came from), signatureStatus and signatureMeans (a valid signature says ASPERN issued these bytes, not that the figures are true); revision: its number for this vault, supersedes (the previous issue’s full id, which stays as issued) and changedConclusions.

scoreReplication.description: The scoring run: scoreRunId, modelVersion, thresholds, usedInputs with exact values and SHA-256 of their inputs, and the unrounded arithmetic. Null on a score written before 2026-11-25.

simulationEvidence.description: One simulation record for the summary and the detail: what was simulated, at which block, and what was not tested. Null where nothing was simulated.

unattributedCapital.description: value (null unless measured), unit, status (measured, not_established or unreconciled_residual), differenceUsd, asOf. Never report null as zero.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

withdrawableFigure.description: The withdrawable figure’s state: zero, dust or unknown, said apart. A dust figure is printed as <$0.01, never $0, and is never the denominator of a percentage (ratioMeaningful false).

withdrawalBounds.description: Taken over positive amounts only: largestTestedSuccess, smallestPositiveTestedFailure (with its revert class), upperBoundJustification and searchExhausted, each null where it does not exist. A call for zero raw units is a zero_amount_test (zeroAmountTests), never a limit. An amount above the simulated holder’s position is not applicable, never failed; one between tested points is only conditionally inferred. materialLimits.simulationRecord.calls carry requestedUsd, quantizedAssetsRaw, actualAsset, actualUsd, decimals, rounding, state and revertClass.

wrapper.description: A wrapper followed to where its money rests: edges (deposit, adapter, underlying-vault, market, collateral), each observed, inferred or unknown with source, block and share; layers with each curator, fees and gates; coverage, curators, fees (each layer counted once), gates (per layer), tvl (never add the two layers), liquidity.

title: Due-diligence report for agents (paid)
